items.pt:
O elétrico YANGWANG U9 Xtreme acaba de ganhar títulos impressionantes. Ambos os feitos receberam também o reconhecimento da Federação Internacional de Automobilismo (FIA).

items.title: The Cassette Take-Home: Grade Whether an Agent Can Be Re-Run Without the Model
items.pt: The most useful signal in an agent take-home is not the quality of the demo output; it is whether a reviewer can reproduce that output offline, without an API key, six weeks later. This task grades that property directly. Candidates make one recording pass against a live model endpoint, commit the recording, and from then on the suite must pass with the network disabled. The exercise takes roughly ninety minutes and leaves behind a small harness the hiring team reuses on every subsequent candida

items.title: Canva cut 1,200 jobs and said small changes will not do
items.pt:
The short answer


Canva is cutting about 22 per cent of its workforce, roughly 1,200 people, either through redundancy or relocation. Chief executive Melanie Perkins told staff that "small changes won't be enough" as the company rebuilds around AI. It is the largest restructuring in the Australian design company's history, and it lands at a moment when the tools Canva sells are being rebuilt by the same technology it is deploying.

items.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
items.pt: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. items.title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
items.pt: ML code should run where researchers choose, not where it was first written. Today, machine learning code mainly lives in two ecosystems, PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs and JAX on Google TPUs. Migrating repositories between them means building and testing across frameworks and hardware. items.title: ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts
items.pt: Reproducing machine learning experiments requires reconstructing procedures from information scattered across papers, released code, and supporting artifacts. For coding agents, reproduction success can therefore depend on their ability to fill in missing details, rather than on the released artifacts alone. We ask whether preserving recovered procedures and decisions improves subsequent independent reproduction. We define a standardized artifact design comprising a refined codebase, environment

items.title: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
items.pt: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. They can use visual plans--points, bounding boxes, and trajectories--to represent spatial goals and anticipate motion. However, autoregressive vision-language models generate these plans one coordinate token at a time, making richer predictions increasingly costly.
